meta.name: native-sim
meta.description: Host-based simulation using the Zephyr native_sim board. Covers building for Linux/macOS/Windows, automated testing, host-side debugging (GDB, Valgrind), and host-target integration. Trigger when developing application logic without hardware or setting up CI/CD tests.

copy.tagline: 在没有硬件的情况下开发和测试 Zephyr 应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要开发 Zephyr 应用但手头没有物理开发板，或需要搭建自动化测试
copy.tagline_en: Develop and test Zephyr applications without physical hardware
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build Zephyr apps without a board or set up automated tests

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮助你使用 Zephyr 的 native_sim 板在主机上编译、运行和调试应用程序，无需实际硬件。它会指导你使用 west、GDB、Valgrind 等工具，以及设置自动化测试。
howto.when: 当你需要开发 Zephyr 应用逻辑但没有硬件，或者要设置 CI/CD 测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 native_sim 构建 hello_world 示例。
say.note: Claude 会给出构建命令和运行步骤。

say.text: 如何用 GDB 调试一个 native_sim 应用？
say.note: Claude 会指导使用 west debug 等调试流程。

say.text: 在 CI 中集成 native_sim 测试需要做什么？
say.note: Claude 会提供使用 twister 的参考和检查清单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you build, run, and debug Zephyr applications on your host machine using the native_sim board, without real hardware. It guides you through tools like west, GDB, Valgrind, and setting up automated tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are developing Zephyr application logic without hardware or setting up CI/CD tests.

say_en.text: Help me build the hello_world sample with native_sim.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the build command and run steps.

say_en.text: How to debug a native_sim application with GDB?
say_en.note: Claude will guide using west debug etc.

say_en.text: What is needed to integrate native_sim tests in CI?
say_en.note: Claude will reference twister and the checklist.
